status: Exploratory feasibility and candidate-state analysis; choices fixed before examining EMT outcomes, not external preregistration
identity: Exact source cell-ID matching; published tumor/DCIS classes are source-supported identity proxies, not genotype-proven malignancy. Hybrid, transitional and unlabeled categories remain separate.
normalization: log1p(10000*counts/total biological counts); same measured panel for reference predictor and Xenium input; primary signatures are equal gene means
emt_program: HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION from the unchanged original h.all.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt; an EMT-associated transcriptomic proxy, not a validated cell-state label
reference: Wu et al. GSE176078, 100064 annotated cells; cancer epithelial cells evaluated separately from other lineages
reference_target: Mean log-normalized expression of Hallmark EMT genes absent from the Xenium panel; epithelial target uses measured reference genes on its separate axis

reference_models.direct: Equal mean of measured Hallmark EMT genes in the panel; no trained weights
reference_models.learned: StandardScaler then Ridge(alpha=100); all panel genes present in reference; training cancer cells only; equal total donor weight; no tuning
reference_models.validation: Leave one reference donor out; preprocessing and training exclude that donor; comparisons only within cancer epithelial cells
reference_models.training_subsample: Fixed seed per donor, used only if donor exceeds the fixed cap
reference_models.feasibility_gate: At least 10 evaluable donors; learned-score median within-donor Spearman >=0.30 and at least 70% of donors have Spearman >=0.30 against the gene-disjoint target. This is a prespecified operational gate, not a biological validation standard.
reference_models.calibration: Passing reference performance is necessary but insufficient; external-reference score is not evidence for directly measured absent genes or successful transfer to Xenium. Do not treat it as EMT ground truth.

direct_tf_candidate: QC-pass source tumor/DCIS cell with >=1 transcript in at least 2 measured canonical EMT TF genes and >=1 measured epithelial gene. This is a TF/epithelial coexpression candidate, not an EMT diagnosis.
nuclear_sensitivity: Repeat TF coexpression counts using overlaps_nucleus==1; losing the criterion may reflect real cytoplasmic transcripts as well as assignment artifacts

spatial_candidate_display.description: Fixed descriptive neighborhoods of measured TF coexpression among source-supported tumor cells; not fixed top quantiles, EMT annotations or significant hotspots. No EMT-zone call if identity/observability is unsupported.

spatial_context: Published cell identities, local stromal/myoepithelial fractions, cell/transcript density, and original histology coordinates; no cell-ID substitution or cell-state imputation without explicit labeling
residual_evaluation: Descriptive within-section associations of cell-level coexpression prevalence with existing corrected score; use residual scores excluding all TF, epithelial, and Hallmark genes to reduce direct arithmetic reuse; summarize separately by section and patient, no spot/cell-independent p-values. Conditional analyses adjust composition, depth and tumor cell count; no generalization claim from two patients.
visium_next_stage: Verify NCBI776 against source GSM7782699 and record whole-transcriptome marker availability/reference compatibility; broader tumor-state modeling requires valid identity/mixture estimates and verified patient grouping
fail_policy: Save all negative findings and maps. Do not change genes, thresholds, reference or labels to recover EMT. If observability fails, retain TF evidence maps and a concrete broader-assay feasibility report, and withhold EMT-zone labels.
verification: Raw transcript counts versus independently downloaded vendor matrices
Nuclear counts subset of total counts
limits: Gene expression does not establish temporal EMT
Published transitional/boundary cells are not automatically EMT
Stromal/myoepithelial mixtures and segmentation artifacts remain alternative explanations
No additional tissue or staining availability has been established
